item.title: Mirror 1.3.0
item.description: - Pick your camera from the Camera menu, including your iPhone - Enhance now judges color and brightness from your face, and is gentler - Meeting view shows exactly what Zoom, Meet and Teams send - Soft light, Pause (Space), and a darker, clearer control panel - Settings: button descriptions, keep on top, and an optional shortcut to open Mirror - The camera turns off while Mirror is hidden or minimized
